title: Preserve accepted lighting and camera language while improving modeling detail and action complexity

humanEvidence.qualitativeFeedbackExact: 我看了视频了，说实话光影和镜头感很好，就是建模太粗糙，动作太简单了。但是我看到非常大的潜力。

gates.title: Read-only hero-asset and action inventory
gates.acceptance: One zero-render start inventories exact hero meshes, topology, materials, modifiers, constraints, actions, F-curves, keyframes, animated targets and nine sentinel-frame transforms without saving or mutating the source.

gates.title: Modeling-detail product increment
gates.acceptance: Add meaningful silhouette, surface and material-region detail to the guardian and console/core, not subdivision-only inflation, while all protected camera and lighting identities pass regression.

gates.title: Action-complexity product increment
gates.acceptance: Add multiple causally timed non-camera action channels and secondary motion across approach, contact, activation and reflection without changing the accepted shot ranges or weakening recovery and receipt controls.

gates.title: Integrated review slice and delayed A/B human review
gates.acceptance: A fresh integrated slice passes machine regressions and a preregistered delayed human comparison judges modeling and action improvements while checking that lighting and camera strengths were retained.

requiredMeasurements: per-mesh vertices, edges, polygons, material slots and modifiers
guardian and console/core component roster and bounding boxes
materials and node counts used by hero assets
actions, slots, F-curves, keyframes, constraints and animated target roster
object and pose transforms at frames 1, 48, 96, 97, 144, 192, 193, 240 and 288
camera transforms/lenses and light transforms/energy/color at the same sentinel frames
source file SHA-256 before and after the process
process argv, stdout/stderr, operation counters and self-hashed root manifest

stopRules: Do not begin PC.1 source or render mutation until PC.0 evidence and an independent inventory audit pass.
Do not modify or save the frozen B62 source scene during PC.0.
Do not count invisible topology inflation or subdivision alone as modeling improvement.
Do not count camera motion, light animation or existing core pulse alone as added action complexity.
Do not degrade the accepted lighting/camera result to make modeling or action metrics easier.
Do not overwrite PB.6/PB.7 media, evidence or verdicts.
Do not create releases, distribute binaries or DMGs, sign, notarize, force-push, update other refs, upload LFS or make account/legal changes.
claimCeiling: This program may show measurable improvement for one inherited stylized B62 slice on one admitted arm64 host. It does not prove final-film quality, general asset quality, production readiness, public distribution, cross-platform behavior or autonomous filmmaking.
